groupLabel.description: What an island is called in this town (Pillar, Team, ...).

mode.description: demo: the town runs on fake data and has the Break things panel and the story bar. live (the default when this is left out): real sources only, nothing to break. Read when the server starts.

topology.description: Whether calls between islands go through the hub.

expectedWarnings.description: Warnings the validator should expect here: a test registry that shows a rule on purpose. They are left out of the report; if one stops appearing, that is an error.

rule.description: The rule name shown in the warning, for example standalone.

file.description: The file it is expected in, relative to the registry folder, for example pillars/sta.yaml. Leave out for any file.
